title: Modeled shade on walks from nearby subway entrances to Seward Park
question: How would a repeated shade gap affect the same representative public-anchor journeys if it reached 80% modeled shade?
geography: Lower Manhattan subway entrances within roughly one kilometer of Seward Park

selectionPolicy.tieBreak: weighted avoidable minutes, affected journey weight, length, then sorted edge IDs

limitations: This is a frozen equal-weight public-anchor cohort, not observed individual app usage or population demand.
The static 2024 subway inventory does not verify live service, entrance access, elevators, or a step-free journey.
The Seward Park fountain is a mapped public anchor; its current operation and water availability are unknown.
Shade is derived from mapped buildings and modeled sun position, and the current validation status is pending.
The intervention is hypothetical and does not establish feasibility, cost, ownership, permitting, or City priority.
exclusions: No resident histories, inferred destinations, or individual-level demand are used.
No claim is made that every relevant journey or neighborhood is represented.
